exposure: breastfeeding in the first hour of life
Information received during prenatal care about breastfeeding
information during prenatal care about the importance of breastfeeding at birth
outcome: Prevalence of breastfeeding in the first hour of life
cohort: 4800 mothers in 12 private maternity hospitals in Brazil participating in the 'Adequate Childbirth Project'
finding: Factors associated with increased breastfeeding in the first hour of life included receiving information during prenatal care about the importance of breastfeeding at birth, being target of the quality-of-care improvement project, and skin-to-skin contact at birth.
mod_finding: This study found that cesarean section delivery was negatively associated with breastfeeding in the first hour of life.
